claim_boundary: A reviewer-facing readiness index for a concept proposal. It records what would be needed to authorize, pause, resume, or close a pilot; it does not name real institutions, approve works, or prove field performance.

state_legend.not_authorized_not_field_run: 未获授权·未现场运行 / not authorised · not field-run
state_legend.role_type_only: 责任角色类型已定义，具体机构未确认 / role type defined, institution unconfirmed
state_legend.evidence_template: 表单与签认模板，不是已取得的现场证据 / template, not collected field evidence

gates.required_record: survey, clearance, quantity schedule, and cost split
drill receipt, stop owner, appeal and rollback test
opening log, baseline, incident log, and public notice

tabletop_replay.claim_boundary: Offline synthetic contract replay only. Passing proves that participant-authored admission, pause, and rejection rules execute consistently; it is not authorisation, field evidence, safety proof, public acceptance, cost evidence, or institutional sign-off.

quantity_and_lifecycle_cost_method.claim_boundary: Participant-authored measurement and cost-planning method. It contains no market rate, currency amount, procurement decision, approved quantity, or budget commitment.

review_navigation.claim_boundary: Navigation only; referenced records remain authoritative.

official_task_trace.claim_boundary: Participant-authored traceability only. It does not certify official boundaries, institutional agreement, professional approval, field performance, budget, procurement, or implementation.

key_area_handoff.claim_boundary: Role types, evidence requirements, and stop/resume rules are participant-authored templates. No real institution is named or implied; all gates remain not started.

scenario_professional_review_matrix.claim_boundary: Participant-authored desktop-review matrix only. It names role types, methods, and missing evidence, not real institutions, statutory approval, engineering capacity, field performance, procurement, or implementation permission.

pre_g3_commissioning_plan.claim_boundary: The participant-authored briefs are complete enough to scope appointment and desktop review. No professional is appointed, no external evidence is received, no budget or procurement is approved, and no field work or G3 pilot is authorised.
